Binance is the leading global blockchain ecosystem and cryptocurrency infrastructure provider whose suite of financial products includes the world’s largest digital-asset exchange.Our mission is to accelerate cryptocurrency adoption and increase the freedom of money.

 Responsibilities 
 
 Development and implementation Backend service for the AI Chatbot products.

 Explore and integrate the LLM applications to improve chatbot performance and user experience.

 Requirements 
 
 Bachelor's/Master's degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent industry experience.
